svg.title: Sentry issuing workload certificates on Kubernetes
svg.desc: On the left of the middle row, an operator figure stands beside a Kubernetes Secret holding the certs, with an arrow from the operator into the secret marked optional, because the operator may bring existing root and issuer certs. A line with a head at each end leaves the secret's top, runs up and along to Sentry, the Dapr certificate authority, which stands in a pod of its own above the middle of the picture, and is labelled "Read the existing root and issuer certs, or create a self-signed root". To the right of the secret and on the same line, App A and App B each run beside a Dapr sidecar in a pod of their own, and the two sidecars are joined by a line with a head at each end carrying a shield and padlock marked mTLS. A line leaves each sidecar on the side facing the other and rises between the two app pods, where the pair merge into one arrow into the bottom of Sentry's pod, labelled "Request a workload certificate, with the pod service account token". A row below the apps, the injector stands in a pod of its own between them. One run leaves its top and forks into both sidecars, labelled "Inject the trust anchors (the root cert)"; another leaves its side, passes under the apps and reaches the secret, labelled "Read the root cert".
